title: ADVANCED APPLICATION OF MARKETING PRINCIPLES
description: Develop an understanding of how a market-orientation can help firms to profitably deliver value to targeted customers. Through a combination of case discussions, preparation of a client project, lectures and in-class activities, analyze complex marketing challenges; make strategic decisions for products, services, and brands, based on marketing principles; and persuasively communicate decisions.
registration_restrictions:
Prerequisites: BA 223, 223H, 390 or 390H.
A minimum grade of C is required in BA 223, BA 223H, BA 390 and BA 390H.

Students with a term class standing of Freshman or Sophomore may not enroll.

Enrollment is limited to students with a program in Marketing (799).
books_html: No-cost: Course utilizes open educational resources, materials available through the library, or does not require any purchased materials.
clssnotes:
Hybrid section; both on-site meetings and online component.
